Challenges to the measurement design are welcome and are treated as first-class
contributions. The project's position is that a confidently wrong number is worse
than no number, so an argument that a number here is misleading is valuable even
when it comes with no code.

## What claim or method are you challenging?

Cite the document and section — e.g. `docs/p2-evaluation.md`, the per-field exact
match rule, the refusal to zero-fill failed jobs, a groundedness gate, the
clerk-year holdout, or a figure in `docs/p2-baseline-addendum.md`.

## What is wrong with it

## What would it change?

Does this change a reported figure, a gate outcome, or only the interpretation?
Be explicit if you believe a published number is overstated.

## What would settle it

An experiment, a counterexample, or a citation. If the answer is "run X and see",
say precisely what X is.
